description: Output history per tool (last 10 generations). Adds a useOutputHistory hook that persists each successful generation to localStorage (10 entries × 50KB cap, 14-day expiry), plus a 'Recent' button on the AIToolPage toolbar that opens a dialog where the teacher can restore any previous output. This is the single most-asked feature in any AI generator product: clicking Regenerate, finding the new output worse, and wanting the old one back.
steps: Create client/src/hooks/useOutputHistory.ts — returns { entries, push, remove, clear, get }. Storage key adaptly_history_v1_<toolSlug>. De-dupes consecutive identical outputs. Auto-evicts oldest beyond 10.
Wire useOutputHistory(toolSlug) inside AIToolPage. Push every successful generation (streaming + non-streaming branches) and every Auto-fix.
Render a 'Recent' button on the toolbar after generation, and on the form (above the input fields) when entries exist.
Add a Recent dialog listing entries newest-first, with a one-click restore that re-populates form values and the result.
Add a 'Clear history' button inside the dialog.
acceptance_criteria: After a successful generation, the entry appears in the Recent dialog.
Restoring an entry repopulates the form and output without re-calling the AI.
History caps at 10 entries; oldest is dropped on push.
History survives page reloads but never leaves the device.
verification: Manual: generate twice, click Recent, restore the older entry.
findings: Verified by --noResolve TS syntax checks. localStorage cap and best-effort eviction follow the same pattern as the existing useDraftAutosave hook.
